sentences.text: Pilosibacter fragilis is the name given to strain CSJ-4, one of three Gram-positive, obligately anaerobic strains isolated from faeces of healthy persons.
Pilosibacter fragilis was placed in the family Clostridiaceae, but a later analysis proposed moving the genus Pilosibacter into the family Lachnospiraceae.
A related gut isolate sharing 97.0% 16S rRNA gene sequence identity with Pilosibacter fragilis CSJ-4 has been reported to be a potent butyrate producer.
